text:
carla: Heads-up — noticed a strange localized p95 queue spike in euc3 (pool-7) starting ~14:10 UTC. Heatmap looks like a narrow band, ~40m duration. Anyone watching the hosted fleet dashboards?
ops-bot: Alert: GPU_POOL_SATURATION firing for euc3/pool-7 (p95_queue_time > 1.2s) :rotating_light: — 2024-05-05T14:12:08Z
josh: yep i see it on grafana, looks like a ripple that correlates with admissions rejects. dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood/d/euc3/pool-heatmap?from=now-1h&to=now
maya: adding context — there was a node refill/maintenance in euc3 at 13:50 UTC that drained 2 r5-gpu hosts. autoscaler refilled but we might have slot fragmentation.
ryan: can you paste the promQL you used for the heatmap? want to check histogram shape and request size distro.
carla: promQL I used:```sum(rate(gpu_pool_queue_time_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (pool, le)``` also slicing by `seqlen` shows tail-heavy traffic — a bunch of requests at 512+ tokens.
anita: note: we deployed a quantized-large model variant to hosted-euc3 yesterday evening. That variant increases KV cache pressure per request, could explain longer queue times for long-seq requests.
josh: logs show admissions throttles for pool-7: `admissions.rejects{pool="pool-7",reason="overcommit"} 152` in last 15m.
leo: quick cost note — if we enable cross-region spillover it will add egress and potential latency (~$0.10-$0.15 per spilled request). want to avoid unless necessary.
maya: two immediate mitigations we can toggle: 1) temp bump admission burst allowance for pool-7 (10%) 2) enable soft cross-pool fallback to eu-central cold pool. Which is less risky?
ryan: I prefer soft-fallback to a cold pool for small % (5%). Bumping admission bursts can allow more large-reqs that increase KV pressure and destabilize the pool.
carla: can someone add per-`seqlen` heatmap + `admissions.rejects` panel side-by-side with p95? that would speed triage.
anita: I'll open a tiny dashboard PR to add `seqlen` grouping + `admissions.rejects` next to the p95 panel. ETA ~30m.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-20240505-1423 — GPU_POOL_SATURATION (euc3/pool-7) — auto-triggered from alert rule.
josh: triage runbook I'm following: 1) enable 5% soft-fallback 2) monitor p95 & admission rejects 3) if p95 > 2x baseline -> scale pool-7 by +2 hosts + trigger refill 4) if correlated with model rollout, rollback variant.
ryan: I'll spin up a small loadtest to reproduce with seqlen=1024 samples and see admission behavior.
carla: thanks — tagging @oncall for visibility. I put the grafana snapshot in the incident doc.
leo: noted for cost ops — will model egress vs. lost-availability tradeoffs if fallback is used a lot.
carla: appreciate the quick responses. we'll reconvene in 30m with dashboard PR + simulation results.
